grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before accessing and updating your DVLA medical records

grants.description: Access your current driving licence details from DVLA records
grants.purpose: To verify your licence and determine which notification process applies to you

grants.description: Share details of your medical condition with DVLA
grants.purpose: To enable DVLA to assess whether your condition affects your fitness to drive and whether any licence restrictions are needed

grants.description: Provide your GP or consultant's contact details for medical verification
grants.purpose: DVLA may need to contact your medical professionals to verify your condition and assess fitness to drive

grants.description: Allow DVLA to create and maintain medical records linked to your licence
grants.purpose: To maintain accurate records of your medical conditions and any restrictions or requirements for your driving licence

revocation.mechanism: Contact DVLA or revoke through your GOV.UK account. Note: Revoking consent does not remove your legal duty to notify DVLA of medical conditions.
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. Your legal duty to notify remains. Failure to notify can result in fines up to £1,000 and may invalidate your insurance.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot voluntarily surrender your licence without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot consent to medical examinations on your behalf. Agent cannot override DVLA's fitness-to-drive decision. Agent can only submit notifications for conditions you explicitly disclose - it cannot infer or diagnose conditions. Agent cannot advise on whether you should continue driving - that is a decision for you, your doctor, and DVLA.
